_doc: FluentBooking vendor-map per PRINCIPLES-VENDOR.md V11. One row per touched ability. Populated incrementally as fix packages land.

abilities.notes: Package 3 (#84) corrected the returned-id shape (P-N/V9). Package 3b corrects a duplicate-write: the prior callback did BOTH a direct wpFluent insertGetId() AND do_action('fluent_booking/log_booking_note'); the vendor LogHandler (app/Hooks/Handlers/LogHandler.php:16-30) listens to that action and ALSO calls BookingActivity::create() — so every call persisted two fcal_booking_activity rows. Now routes once through the vendor canonical model FluentBooking\App\Models\BookingActivity::create (the same model the LogHandler uses), returning $activity->id for the V9 round-trip and writing exactly one row. The do_action is dropped (LogHandler only persists; no other side effect). V10 typed WP_Error when the vendor model class is absent. Live re-test helenawillow 2026-05-16: one row persisted (id=3298), id round-trip confirmed, created_by auto-set by the vendor model creating-hook.

Package 2 V10 fix (F-BOOK-01). Vendor AvailabilityService::getDefaultSchedule() can call reset() on a null schedule list when the calendar user has no configured availability, raising a PHP TypeError that previously bubbled as a fatal. Registrar now wraps the getDefaultSchedule call in try/catch and returns WP_Error('vendor_precondition_failed', …). CalendarSlot::create remains the canonical write path.
abilities.read_back: N/A — P-K V10 typed-error-guard only; CalendarSlot::create write path unchanged (no state-change write / carry-forward)

abilities.notes: Package 4a special (V5 P-H; P2-deferred — P-K TimeSlotService crash already fixed P2/#83). Vendor source: FluentBooking TimeSlotService::getDates() returns a date-KEYED map (keys=Y-m-d, values=slot arrays); output_schema declared days as sequential array. Fix: union-declare days ['object','array'] (date keys are semantically meaningful — not flattened/discarded). Schema-only. Product-level (vendor-contract), site-agnostic. LIVE-VERIFIED via probe on helenawillow (incidental test surface), 2026-05-16: pre-deploy reproduced output[days] not-of-type-array; post-deploy get-available-slots(event_id=3,2026-05-20..22,Europe/Stockholm) -> days returned as date-keyed map {'2026-05-20':[...],...} and ACCEPTED by the union schema. Restored to baseline, 0 residue. Multisite dimension: config-agnostic by construction; single-site probe only (flagged, not gating).
